blocks.text: Tasveer banane ka yeh tareeqa taqatwar magnetic field aur radio waves se jism ke andaruni hisson ki tafseeli tasveerein banata hai. MRI ka bunyadi usool yeh hai ke jism ke mukhtalif tissues mein hydrogen atoms ki miqdar mukhtalif hoti hai, aur hydrogen atoms mein magnetic khasusiyat (properties) hoti hai.

Tareeqa: mareez motor wali mez par hota hai jo ek bari tube-numa machine mein khisakti hai jise scanner kehte hain. Scanner mein ek taqatwar magnet hai jo mareez ke jism ke gird mazboot magnetic field banata hai. Phir radio waves se jism ke hydrogen atoms se signal nikalwaya jata hai. Yeh signals ek receiver pakarta hai. Computer is maloomat se andaruni hisson ki tafseeli, teen-jihati (three-dimensional) tasveer banata hai.

blocks.alt: MRI scanner ka kata hua manzar. Mareez motorized table par leta hai jo scanner ki surang mein khisakti hai. Surang ke oopar aur neeche bare magnet coils hain aur surang ki deewar par radio waves source hai.

blocks.text: Istemal: MRI naram tissues, jaise dimagh, spinal cord aur andaruni aaza, ki tasveer ke liye, aur khoon ki nalyon aur kuch qisam ke tumours ki kharabi dhoondne ke liye istemal hota hai.

blocks.explanation: Jism ke tissues ke hydrogen atoms, jinhein taqatwar magnetic field mein radio waves signal dene par majboor karti hain.
